job: Plot 1, The Rectory, Bates Hill, Ightham TN15 9BG

stages.title: Ground floor walls
stages.desc: Nudura 6in XR35, 6 courses (0 - 2,743) straight off the slab: the full ground-floor envelope with the two front bays, the porch, the rear kitchen bay and every door / window opening (bucks, end caps and lintel closures). Every form is the real Nudura block as it would be laid.

stages.title: First floor walls and front gables
stages.desc: Courses 7 - 12 to the wall plate (5,486 above GF FFL) with the first-floor windows, and the two front gables raked at 45 degrees to the roof (left gable ICF over the bay only).
